SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.
   C. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
